title: Iran-First Authority & Original Citation Assets

strategy_change.decision: Cold email / manufacturer reply is not an acceptance gate for Iran.
strategy_change.reason: Low practical response rate from companies makes reply-dependent outreach unreliable for execution.
strategy_change.historical_outreach_assets: retained as optional evidence only; not required for completion

required: Original deterministic tools/methodology with stated assumptions and limits
Verified product/compatibility data with unknown fields left unknown
Search-demand evidence from Search Console and on-site/customer questions
Anonymized first-party support/question patterns without exposing customer data
Practical decision pages: suitable/not-suitable, selection inputs, common mistakes and troubleshooting
Real owned or consented field/installation media when available; never fabricate field evidence
Visible trust, methodology, author/reviewer and correction policy
Reusable tables/checklists/calculators that external users or AI systems can cite

iran_first_execution_loop.action: Mine real questions and buying mistakes from Search Console, site questions and support interactions.
iran_first_execution_loop.privacy_rule: Store patterns/categories, not customer identity or private message content.

iran_first_execution_loop.action: Turn repeated questions into decision pages, troubleshooting notes, comparison tables and calculator methodology.
Link each claim to verified first-party data, official manufacturer/public source, or clearly stated unknown.
Repurpose the same evidence into site content, Instagram, Telegram and WhatsApp channels without changing the factual core.
Measure demand, clicks, indexed pages, assisted product discovery and AI/search citations; improve based on observed demand.

outreach_templates.note: Keep existing templates only for opportunistic use when a real relationship/contact exists. Do not wait for replies.

completion_basis: Phase completion is based on controllable first-party authority/citation assets and anti-fabrication safeguards, not external email replies.
